title: DAO Proposals — Walrus-Backed Bodies, On-Chain Tallies
summary: Build a Governance contract whose on-chain state is just (proposer, blobId, deadline, yes, no) per proposal. The proposer pays Walrus for the body upfront; voters read the body from the public aggregator and cast a token-weighted yes/no. Includes the flash-loan-vulnerability warning that separates the showcase shape from a production-safe pattern.
